g.text: 24 V Electronic Fuse and Reverse-Polarity Protection

g.desc: 24 V Electronic Fuse and Reverse-Polarity Protection

g.text: C304 (100 nF) sets an output slew rate of approximately 0.5 V/ms, giving

g.desc: C304 (100 nF) sets an output slew rate of approximately 0.5 V/ms, giving

g.text: a nominal 48 ms ramp to 24 V. Increasing C304 slows startup and reduces

g.desc: a nominal 48 ms ramp to 24 V. Increasing C304 slows startup and reduces

g.text: capacitive inrush. Closing JP301 grounds SHDN_N and disables U301.

g.desc: capacitive inrush. Closing JP301 grounds SHDN_N and disables U301.

g.text: Reopening JP301 enables operation and can reset an overload latch.

g.desc: Reopening JP301 enables operation and can reset an overload latch.

g.text: R301=13.7k / R302=14.3k (0.1%, 25ppm/K) protect the 36 V module.

g.desc: R301=13.7k / R302=14.3k (0.1%, 25ppm/K) protect the 36 V module.

g.text: Nominal UVLO turn-on remains 16.63 V; OVP cutoff is now 33.99 V.

g.desc: Nominal UVLO turn-on remains 16.63 V; OVP cutoff is now 33.99 V.

g.text: Nominal recovery from OVP is 31.78 V. Design input: 24 V nominal;

g.desc: Nominal recovery from OVP is 31.78 V. Design input: 24 V nominal;

g.text: 18-30 V continuous candidate range, not the former 18-36 V assumption.

g.desc: 18-30 V continuous candidate range, not the former 18-36 V assumption.

g.text: R305=5.1k and MODE latch-off are unchanged. Validate surge let-through

g.desc: R305=5.1k and MODE latch-off are unchanged. Validate surge let-through

g.text: and all tolerance/temperature corners before hardware release.

g.desc: and all tolerance/temperature corners before hardware release.

g.text: R308-R310 set the PGTH threshold to approximately 16.20 V rising and

g.desc: R308-R310 set the PGTH threshold to approximately 16.20 V rising and

g.text: 15.16 V falling. PG_INPUT asserts only when the output passes this

g.desc: 15.16 V falling. PG_INPUT asserts only when the output passes this

g.text: threshold and U301's internal pass transistor is fully enhanced.

g.desc: threshold and U301's internal pass transistor is fully enhanced.

g.text: R307 pulls this open-drain signal up to AON.

g.desc: R307 pulls this open-drain signal up to AON.

g.text: +24V_FUSED supplies U301 (TPS26631) through Q301 (IRFR3410). U301 controls

g.desc: +24V_FUSED supplies U301 (TPS26631) through Q301 (IRFR3410). U301 controls

g.text: Q301 via B_GATE; Q302 provides gate pull-down under DRV control. Together

g.desc: Q301 via B_GATE; Q302 provides gate pull-down under DRV control. Together

g.text: with U301, these transistors provide reverse-polarity and reverse-current

g.desc: with U301, these transistors provide reverse-polarity and reverse-current

g.text: protection. The protected output is EFUSE_OUT. C301-C303 decouple the input;

g.desc: protection. The protected output is EFUSE_OUT. C301-C303 decouple the input;

g.text: C305 decouples the output. D301 clamps negative output transients.

g.desc: C305 decouples the output. D301 clamps negative output transients.
